title: A bibliometric analysis of low-temperature proton exchange membrane fuel cells: linking materials innovation to performance and durability trends
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D6SE00424E, Review Article
Siti Haziyah Mohd Chachuli, Muhammad Asyraf Abdullah, Kean Long Lim, Wai Yin Wong, Kee Shyuan Loh, Sharifah Najiha Timmiati
Low-temperature proton exchange membrane fuel cells are key to the hydrogen economy. This bibliometric analysis reveals the evolution of catalyst research from Pt-based systems to durable PGM-free electrocatalysts, highlighting emerging trends, global collaborations and future research priorities.
